common_refs.rubric: De Communi sanctorum virorum, p. 311, praeter hymnos sequentes ad libitum:

flags: Bernard's Vespers hymn (Bernardus doctor inclitus) final stanza + Amen is at top of p590 (continues); nothing follows it before Die 25 augusti.

Louis uses existing UNIVERSAL epoch louis-king-of-france (25 Aug, rank UNDETERMINED); C.S.G. scope (French Solesmes houses) recorded in this flag, no OSB-specific epoch. Rank marker not printed, so no override.

Common = COM-SANCT-VIR-UNO (a king, one man; page prints no subject heading). Hymns are 'ad libitum' so after_common: true (Common hymn stays option 1). The Lauds hymn Iucundetur Ecclesia is printed on p591 and is assigned there.

Gaude mater Ecclesia (H.VIII, Ludovici) is in the LH index (row 5261, p590) as unmatched and has no Solesmes/LH edition in gregobase; the only same-incipit chants (4587, 4696) are Dominican mode 7 and were rejected. Rows use allow_unresolved (chant_uuid NULL) pending a new gregobase import.
